facts.fact: A GIZ ProDigiT LinkedIn post says the Ministry-initiated Digital Ambassadors programme run by Agence Togo Digital graduated 80 civil servants placed in 27 ministries and agencies after 14 months, and that a programme to train 20,000 civil servants in basic digital skills is to launch in the coming months.
